wLineRecord.derivation: Alphabetical run 9 (CHARCOAL POWDER) to 15 (SODIUM DEHYDROACETATE): exactly 7 ascending entries (CHARCOAL POWDER, CITRIC ACID, POLYGLYCERIN-10, POLYGLYCERYL-10 MYRISTATE, POLYGLYCERYL-10 STEARATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, SODIUM DEHYDROACETATE); BENZOIC ACID@16 breaks it and GUAR...@8 precedes it out of order. It does not contain the earliest cleansing surfactant (AMMONIUM LAURYL SULFATE@2), so it is a tail; its second entry CITRIC ACID@10 is the candidate (class d). No class a/b/c candidate precedes position 10. (i) ALS@2 before it; (ii) the run's own entries are ignored, and after the run (16-20: Benzoic Acid, Caramel, Linalool, Limonene, Benzyl Alcohol) there is no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide or pearlizing wax before the cap 21 -> plausible. W-line 10.

cleansingStrength.rationale: strong by C5: the defining anionic is AMMONIUM LAURYL SULFATE@2 (alkyl sulfate type) with only one prominent buffer (COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE@4); C5 needs at least two buffers for moderate. The polyglyceryl esters @12-13 are neither routes nor buffers (C3). Counter-signals recorded (oil @5, guar @8) do not touch the buffer count.

conditioningLevel.rationale: moderate: one meaningful system - cationic guar (GUAR HYDROXYPROPYLTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE@8) with a prominent plant oil (NIGELLA SATIVA SEED OIL@5) - plus light polyglyceryl ester refatting (@12-13). C2 is not met: no silicone (the oil may take its place) but no pearlizing/fatty route and no humectant from the closed list (Polyglycerin-10 is not on it). Counter-signal: strong alkyl-sulfate chassis with charcoal is cleansing-led, so low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.rationale: moderate: W-RICH is established (material NIGELLA SATIVA SEED OIL@5, before the W-line CITRIC ACID@10, converging with cationic guar@8), but reset is strong (C5 alkyl sulfate with one buffer), so the rich route does not reach high; the convergence route (one oil + one guar) is offset by the strong reset. W-RICH recorded as counter-signal, high as neighbor (6.7 limited-reset rule).

weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high needs W-RICH with weak reset or converging persistent systems that reset does not offset; reset is strong and there is no silicone, cationic conditioner, protein or film former.
